'''''Chaetonychia''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s belonging to the family [[Caryophyllaceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=Chaetonychia (DC.) Sweet {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:19921-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=21 March 2021 |language=en}}</ref> It is [[monotypic]], being represented by the single species '''''Chaetonychia cymosa'''''.
Its native range is the western Mediterranean.<ref name="POWO" />
